got: countFor maps the brief spine to counts.requirements (JdsIntakeLayoutTriptych.tsx:46). Live, brief.requirements is EMPTY in every session driven this run — including one whose requestor twice stated 'Tvrdá podmínka je Java a Kafka v produkci' — while the same brief holds a title, a seniority, seven context facets and two 90-day success criteria. Folding it produces 'button "Zobrazit: Živé zadání": Živé zadání 0'. So two of the three spines badge zero on a rich session, and the folded Triptych reads as an empty workspace.
evidence: uat/runs/2026-08-10-intake-triptych/shots/l2-briefspine-folded.aria.txt line 58 ('Živé zadání 0'); uat/runs/2026-08-10-intake-triptych/shots/l2-nurse-fold-folded.aria.txt line 37 ('Popis pozice 0'); JdsIntakeLayoutTriptych.tsx:46-47; data/kp.sqlite role_intakes brief_json for intake-msn3bnnp-negmkh (requirements: [], successCriteria: 2, facets: 7)
scope_note: L1 missed this — a surface-model gap: the L1 walkers read countFor's draft branch and stopped, never pairing the brief branch against live brief shape. Fixing the draft badge alone (backlog #4) leaves this one lying.
suggested_acceptance: Fold each of the three leaves on a session with a drafted JD and a populated brief; every spine badge reflects what its OWN leaf holds (draftReady, turn count, brief content), never zero.

title: Explicitly confirmed dealbreakers never land in the structured brief's requirements[]
expected: 'Tvrdá podmínka je Java a Kafka v produkci' — stated once, confirmed again on the next turn — appears under 'Nezbytné / Výhodou' in the Live brief, where the requestor can see and correct it before it steers the build.
got: requirements[] is [] in all three sessions driven live (3-turn API, 3-turn browser, and the pre-existing 14-turn 'Java vývojář do platebního týmu'), and no facet carries the skills either. The edit sheet's 'Nezbytné / Výhodou' block therefore shows an empty adder on a brief whose owner has twice named his hard conditions. MITIGATION (why this is minor, not major): needText carries them, so the built JD is correct — t9u3iv9w's 'Co byste měli mít' opens 'Java — produkční zkušenost (potvrzená tvrdá podmínka requestora)'. The defect is representational: what the requestor can inspect and edit is thinner than what the system actually knows.
evidence: data/kp.sqlite role_intakes.brief_json for intake-msn37gpv-uzfcle, intake-msn3bnnp-negmkh, intake-msjfv1c9-v0x8ub (all requirements: []); uat/runs/2026-08-10-intake-triptych/shots/l2-nurse-edit-landed.aria.txt (empty 'Nezbytné / Výhodou' adder); jds.body for x2bhps4p and t9u3iv9w (both name Java + Kafka)
scope_note: Compounds L2-CONV-1: the empty array is also what the brief spine badge counts.
suggested_acceptance: State a hard skill and confirm it on the next turn; it appears as a must-have row in the Live brief and in the edit sheet.

title: The L1-pass happy path holds live end to end, at honest latency
expected: intake dialog -> brief -> live draft -> promote, unsupervised, in one sitting.
got: Driven live through the real composer in Czech: opener, then three exchanges at 22.4s / 52.3s / 33.3s, then 'Vytvořit inzerát' clicked and settled in 8.0s, producing JD x2bhps4p (analysis_status ready, 'Senior backend engineer — platební tým'). No timeout, no dead-end, no lost turn; the composer's disabled-while-in-flight state made the wait legible. Czech round-tripped intact through the real composer. Total ~2 minutes of model time for a promoted, provenance-tracked posting.

title: REFUTED — Czech diacritics are not corrupted on the way into the transcript
expected: (candidate finding raised mid-run) A session driven via the API stored its Czech user turn as mojibake ('Odch?z? n?m ?lov?k'), which would be a UTF-8 handling defect.
got: Refuted by control. The same sentence submitted through the REAL composer (drive-intake.mjs, intake-msn3bnnp-negmkh) stored as 'Odchází nám člověk z platebního týmu — nechci nabírat podle starého inzerátu…' — perfectly intact. The corruption was introduced by the Windows Git-Bash curl payload, not by the app. Recorded so a future run does not re-raise it.
evidence: data/kp.sqlite role_intakes.transcript_json for intake-msn3bnnp-negmkh (clean) vs intake-msn37gpv-uzfcle (mojibake, curl-submitted)
ceiling: Only the JSON body path was controlled. Nothing here says anything about file-upload or clipboard paths — the attachments API has no file kind, so there was none to test.
